_comment: Copy to past_employers.json (gitignored) and fill in your real tenure dates. LinkedIn's connections export has no employment history for your connections — only the date you connected. So a connection made during one of these windows is inferred to be a colleague from that employer and tagged tie_type=dormant. The evidence is written to tie_basis so you can correct wrong guesses by hand. Dates are YYYY-MM. Omit 'end' for a current role.
